title: K Closest Points to Origin
prompt: Given an array of points where points[i] = [xi, yi] represents a point on the X-Y plane and an integer k, return the k closest points to the origin (0, 0). The distance between two points on the X-Y plane is the Euclidean distance.
hints: Sort by distance squared (avoid sqrt): d^2 = x^2 + y^2. Return first k points.
Or use a max-heap of size k: keep k smallest. When heap full and new point is closer than max, pop and push.
QuickSelect can do O(n) average. Sort is O(n log n) - simpler.
O(n log k) with heap, O(n log n) with sort.
